ownerModel.tlps: TLPS event, production, marketplace, finance and spatial business capabilities
ownerModel.shared: Cross-product identity, organisation, project, communication, evidence, intelligence and public capabilities

maataa.rationale: Platform control-plane settings, integrations, feature flags, and retention capabilities belong to the MAATAA platform product.

shared.rationale: These are cross-product identity, tenancy, project, governance, shared intelligence, communication, and public-surface capabilities; a shared service remains the authority even when both products consume it.

tlps.rationale: These contexts model TLPS event and production workflows, their people and assets, commerce/finance, investor, and spatial/event operations.

limitations: This allocation is for local development and service-boundary design; it does not assert production deployment or business/legal ownership approval.
Canonical foreign-key contracts remain unchanged. Cross-owner SQLite projections omit the physical constraint and retain an explicit service-reference record.
Generated database files are empty schema fixtures, not production baselines or migration authorization.
SQLite's Prisma DDL emits bare JSON object/array defaults that SQLite cannot parse; local projections quote those JSON literals as text without changing canonical contracts.
